Russian frigate fires flares at Danish helicopter over Baltic Sea

A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish military helicopter over the Baltic Sea, according to the Danish military. The incident occurred off the Danish coast. Denmark's Prime Minister condemned the action as 'reckless'. Russia stated that Danish pilots were being provocative. This exchange represents a pattern of verbal disputes along NATO's eastern edge.
